blush-petal.name: Blush petal
blush-petal.piece: One rounded flower petal in dusty blush felt, a soft teardrop that is wide at the top and narrows to a point, gently cupped so its edge curls up.

cream-petal.name: Cream petal
cream-petal.piece: One long flower petal in warm cream felt, slightly twisted along its length, with its tip curled over like a small wave.

pollen-puff.name: Pollen puff
pollen-puff.piece: One small round puff of soft ochre wool, fluffy and slightly uneven, like a ball of pollen, glowing faintly warm from inside.

sage-bud.name: Sage bud
sage-bud.piece: One closed flower bud in muted sage felt, a plump drop shape with two tiny wrapped sepals at its base and no stem.
